sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the
equipment inspection checklist I3, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The boiler area 
sump pump (2 per unit) discharge
the condensate from boiler area sump to water treatment area

The technical specification of the condensate pump: 
R.P.M = 1450 
Suction pressure: 9144 mm H2O
T = 49/25C 
Discharge pressure: 304.8 mm H2O
HP = 10 Q = 10.3 LPS
MODEL = L.G P017 A,B

The first draft initiated by eng.
Ali El-Safoury, tested by eng. Mohamed Anwar Ghazy, accepted by general director 
eng. Gamal Abd El-Meguid El-Safoury, and approved by eng. Mohamed El-Tahawy: head sector of Shoubra El-Khimah PS.

تم تنقيح هذه الوثيقة بواسطة المهندس. Nageh Soliman Shousha: 
 CEPC quality control director, and certified by eng. Afaf Ebrahim 
 El-Dib: CEPC inspection & quality control's Head Sector and MPIS coordinator.
احتياطات السلامة

Work order must be issued and the
maintenance staff should the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety 
helmet, shoes, earplugs etc.

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه

Lubricate 
bearing

Start P/P and check packing leakage 
and change the packing if needed

Listen for unusual noise 
and repair the cause of abnormal noise

تحقق من درجة حرارة تحمل 
لذا افحص الزيت وقم بتغييره إذا لزم الأمر أو افحص المحمل (التشحيم أو 
التغيير).

Record P/P discharge
press.

Clean sludge from bottom of tank 
manually by the buckets, brooms and special tools and the get rid of them 
safely.

Inspect placite
lining of tank for checking or repair this layer of the tank.
